glossary.customer: Consumer customers only exist as CustomerKey on FactInternetSales; no customer dimension is loaded in this deployment.
glossary.profit: Approximated as SalesAmount - TotalProductCost (no explicit profit column is stored).

Class.description: Quality tier classification of the product (e.g. L=Low, M=Medium, H=High).
Class.name: Class

DaysToManufacture.description: Lead time in days required to manufacture one unit.
DaysToManufacture.name: DaysToManufacture

EndDate.description: Date this product record stopped being effective (NULL if still active).
EndDate.name: EndDate

FinishedGoodsFlag.description: 1 if the product is a sellable finished good, 0 if it is a component.
FinishedGoodsFlag.name: FinishedGoodsFlag

ListPrice.description: Manufacturer's suggested retail list price per unit.
ListPrice.name: ListPrice

ModelName.description: Product model family name; groups size/color variants of the same model.
ModelName.name: ModelName

ProductAlternateKey.description: Natural business product code (SKU) from the source system.
ProductAlternateKey.name: ProductAlternateKey

ProductKey.description: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying a product.
ProductKey.name: ProductKey

ProductLine.description: High-level product line code (e.g. R=Road, M=Mountain, T=Touring, S=Standard).
ProductLine.name: ProductLine

ProductSubcategoryKey.description: Key of the product subcategory this product belongs to (grouping key).
ProductSubcategoryKey.name: ProductSubcategoryKey

ReorderPoint.description: Inventory level at which the product should be reordered.
ReorderPoint.name: ReorderPoint

StartDate.description: Date this product record became effective.
StartDate.name: StartDate

Status.description: Current lifecycle status of the product (e.g. Current, Discontinued).
Status.name: Status

Style.description: Target fit/style of the product (e.g. U=Unisex, M=Men's, W=Women's).
Style.name: Style

DimProduct.description: Product dimension. One row per product sold by AdventureWorks, including pricing, cost, physical attributes and lifecycle status.

CustomerKey.description: Identifier of the purchasing consumer customer.
CustomerKey.name: CustomerKey

DiscountAmount.description: Discount amount applied to the line.
DiscountAmount.name: DiscountAmount

DueDate.description: Calendar date the order was due.
DueDate.name: DueDate

DueDateKey.description: Integer YYYYMMDD key for the due date.
DueDateKey.name: DueDateKey

InternetSalesKey.description: Surrogate primary key of the sales order line.
InternetSalesKey.name: InternetSalesKey

OrderDate.description: Calendar date the order was placed.
OrderDate.name: OrderDate

OrderDateKey.description: Integer YYYYMMDD key for the order date.
OrderDateKey.name: OrderDateKey

OrderQuantity.description: Number of units ordered on this line.
OrderQuantity.name: OrderQuantity

ProductKey.description: Product sold on this line (foreign key to DimProduct).
ProductKey.name: ProductKey

ProductStandardCost.description: Standard cost per unit at time of sale.
ProductStandardCost.name: ProductStandardCost

PromotionKey.description: Identifier of the promotion/discount campaign applied, if any.
PromotionKey.name: PromotionKey

SalesAmount.description: Net revenue recognized for this line. Primary revenue measure.
SalesAmount.name: SalesAmount

SalesTerritoryKey.description: Identifier of the sales territory/region attributed to the order.
SalesTerritoryKey.name: SalesTerritoryKey

ShipDateKey.description: Integer YYYYMMDD key for the ship date.
ShipDateKey.name: ShipDateKey

TotalProductCost.description: Total standard cost for the line (ProductStandardCost * OrderQuantity).
TotalProductCost.name: TotalProductCost

UnitPriceDiscountPct.description: Discount percentage applied to the unit price.
UnitPriceDiscountPct.name: UnitPriceDiscountPct
